ios.desc:
Quote Buster helps homeowners get a quick fair-price estimate before talking to a contractor.
Describe the job, answer a few simple questions, and Quote Buster gives you an AI-generated local price range based on job scope, urgency, location, and common market pricing factors. Use Quote Buster to:
  - Estimate home repair and improvement jobs
  - Understand whether a quote sounds reasonable
  - Save past estimates for later review
  - Ask follow-up questions with deep-dive analysis
  - Get a clearer starting point before hiring a pro

  Quote Buster is built for common home projects like plumbing, HVAC, electrical, appliance repair, painting, flooring, roofing, and more.
